chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan narrated, saying: Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj narrated, saying: Al-Abbas ibn Yazid al-Abdi narrated, saying: Gundar narrated to me, saying: Shu'ayb narrated to us from Nawbah al-Saymari, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Umm Salama, from Abu Salama, that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did not fast a complete month from the year except Shaban, linking it with Ramadan.

key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: The ninth month of the Islamic lunar calendar, known for obligatory fasting
key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: The eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar
key_terms.يَصِلُ بِهِ: Linking it with / connecting it to

ai.seo_question: Which month did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) fast completely besides Ramadan?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) uniquely observed the entirety of the month of Shaban in fasting, serving as a spiritual preparation to bridge the gap between the voluntary acts of Shaban and the obligatory fasts of Ramadan. This practice highlights the month's significance in Shia tradition as a time for increasing devotion and seeking forgiveness before the arrival of the 'Month of Allah.'
